title: Library transcription default still selects optional local MLX backend
reasoning: The repository contract says Groq is the default transcriber and warns not to make the default local-only, but the packaged pipeline API still defaults transcribe(..., backend='mlx'). A direct library caller using the normal non-local setup will hit the optional mlx_whisper import error instead of the documented Groq default. The CLI passes an explicit backend, so this mainly affects the pipeline library surface.
recommendation: Change the transcribe default to 'groq' and update the module docstring, or make the default explicit-only if the library API should not choose a backend.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The linked tests cover aggregator, downloader, and extractor behavior, but there is no transcriber test asserting the default backend selection or the normal setup without the local extra.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a transcriber unit test that monkeypatches _transcribe_groq/_transcribe_mlx and asserts transcribe(..., output_path missing) dispatches to Groq when backend is omitted.
minimumFixScope: pipeline/transcriber.py default argument/docstring plus a focused transcriber test.
